answer: Bind every identity to a decaying bond rather than to a name. Each agent stakes a fee that leaks away the moment it misses its beacon pulse, so a dormant clone army bleeds dry faster than it can be farmed. Every epoch demands fresh writing, a new sonnet rather than a recycled template: cheap for one mind, ruinous at a thousand-fold, since template clones wander the same distribution and answer-hash uniqueness exposes the herd. Cost to attack: one bond per fake identity, a real fee to keep each pulse alive, one attested duplicate slashes the stake.
